label: Contabo
description: Read cloud metadata and trigger on new instances, image updates and new snapshots

operations.name: list_instances
operations.description: Read one protected instance page with IDs, states, time, capacity, region and OS metadata.

operations.name: get_instance
operations.description: Read the exact protected numeric instance ID and verify the singleton data array.

operations.name: list_images
operations.description: Read one image page with IDs, format, sizes, OS/version and standard/custom flags. No source URLs or error text.

operations.name: get_image
operations.description: Read the exact existing image ID and verify the singleton data array.

operations.name: list_snapshots
operations.description: First verify the exact parent instance, then read one page whose snapshots all match that parent.

operations.name: get_snapshot
operations.description: Verify the instance parent and exact snapshot ID; metadata only, no restore or download.

operations.name: image_stats
operations.description: Read documented currentImagesCount and total/used/free image MB only; no customer or tenant fields.

operations.name: on_new_instance
operations.description: Poll instances ordered by createdDate. Existing resources form a quiet baseline. Watch the 100 most recently created resources; choose a schedule frequent enough to keep new resources in this window.

operations.name: on_new_or_updated_image
operations.description: Poll images ordered by lastModifiedDate. Emit each unseen image ID and modification timestamp after baselining. Watch the 100 most recent resources; choose a schedule frequent enough to keep changes in this window.

operations.name: on_new_snapshot
operations.description: Poll snapshots ordered by createdDate within the selected instance. Existing snapshots form a quiet baseline. Watch the 100 most recent resources; choose a schedule frequent enough to keep changes in this window.
